title: Sandcrawler
caption: Sandcrawler (V)
game_text: Permanent driver provides no ability. May add 7 passengers. Jawas at same site are power +1 and forfeit +2. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a Jawa here.
lore: Warren-like, enclosed homes for Jawa tribes. Protects against Tatooine predators. Originally mining vehicles. Jawas claimed them when mines abandoned. No two look alike.

notes: LIGHT side Sandcrawler (wiki base page 'Sandcrawler'; the Dark one is 'Sandcrawler (Dark)', slip 43). Non-unique (no dot). Icon column: one icon, a yellow square with a black pilot helmet = the Permanent Pilot (driver) icon → named 'permanent-pilot'. No scomp ring. Deploy 3 / forfeit 3 on the slip (printed card forfeit 5). The crop cuts the bottom strip: caption read as 'Sandcrawler (V)' from the partially visible strip and the slip title; number 22 from the filename/sheet order. Lore corrected from scan: 'Warren-like, enclosed' has a comma (wiki omits it). Base scan: Premiere-L-sandcrawler-decipher-archive.gif (367×506 incl. grey border) is the printed face and the widest; the 350 px Premiere-L-sandcrawler.gif is the PC Errata face (tagged 'E') — also downloaded to src/vs2/, not used. Copyright year 1995 (Premiere), not legible. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1-L-sandcrawler-pre.gif, 350×489) — used as modern.
